create or replace function public.accept_operator_application(p_application_id uuid, p_slug text, p_why_selected text default null::text, p_publish boolean default false)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public'
as $function$
declare
  application_row public.operator_applications%rowtype;
  created_place_id uuid;
  created_operator_id uuid;
  clean_slug text;
begin
  select * into application_row
  from public.operator_applications
  where id = p_application_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'operator application not found';
  end if;

  if application_row.status = 'rejected' then
    raise exception 'rejected application cannot be accepted';
  end if;

  clean_slug := lower(regexp_replace(trim(p_slug), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', 'g'));
  clean_slug := trim(both '-' from clean_slug);

  if clean_slug = '' then
    raise exception 'invalid operator slug';
  end if;

  insert into public.places (slug, name, kind, address, google_maps_query, latitude, longitude)
  values (
    'operatore-' || clean_slug,
    application_row.business_name,
    'operator',
    coalesce(application_row.address, application_row.location),
    concat_ws(' ', application_row.business_name, application_row.location),
    application_row.latitude,
    application_row.longitude
  )
  on conflict (slug) do update
    set name = excluded.name,
        kind = 'operator',
        address = excluded.address,
        google_maps_query = excluded.google_maps_query,
        latitude = excluded.latitude,
        longitude = excluded.longitude,
        updated_at = now()
  returning id into created_place_id;

  insert into public.operators (
    slug, name, description, category, address, latitude, longitude,
    phone, whatsapp, email, website, instagram,
    selection_status, why_selected, published, place_id
  ) values (
    clean_slug,
    application_row.business_name,
    application_row.description,
    application_row.category,
    coalesce(application_row.address, application_row.location),
    application_row.latitude,
    application_row.longitude,
    application_row.phone,
    application_row.whatsapp,
    application_row.email,
    application_row.website,
    application_row.instagram,
    'selected',
    p_why_selected,
    p_publish,
    created_place_id
  )
  returning id into created_operator_id;

  update public.operator_applications
  set status = 'accepted',
      reviewed_at = now(),
      review_notes = p_why_selected,
      operator_id = created_operator_id
  where id = p_application_id;

  return created_operator_id;
end;
$function$;

create or replace function public.get_operator_action_metrics(p_operator_slugs text[], p_window_days integer default 30)
returns table(operator_slug text, total bigint, whatsapp bigint, phone bigint, directions bigint, website bigint, instagram bigint, booking bigint)
language sql
stable
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
  with bounds as (
    select coalesce(max(a.created_at), '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz) as anchor
    from public.analytics_events a
  ), filtered as (
    select
      a.properties->>'operator_id' as operator_slug,
      coalesce(
        nullif(a.properties->>'action_type', ''),
        case a.event_name
          when 'whatsapp_click' then 'whatsapp'
          when 'phone_click' then 'phone'
          when 'directions_click' then 'directions'
          when 'website_click' then 'website'
          when 'instagram_click' then 'instagram'
          when 'booking_click' then 'booking'
          else null
        end
      ) as action
    from public.analytics_events a
    cross join bounds b
    where a.created_at >= b.anchor - make_interval(days => greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_window_days, 30), 90)))
      and a.event_name = any(array['whatsapp_click','phone_click','directions_click','website_click','instagram_click','booking_click']::text[])
      and a.properties->>'operator_id' = any(coalesce(p_operator_slugs, array[]::text[]))
  )
  select
    f.operator_slug,
    count(*)::bigint as total,
    count(*) filter (where f.action = 'whatsapp')::bigint as whatsapp,
    count(*) filter (where f.action = 'phone')::bigint as phone,
    count(*) filter (where f.action = 'directions')::bigint as directions,
    count(*) filter (where f.action = 'website')::bigint as website,
    count(*) filter (where f.action = 'instagram')::bigint as instagram,
    count(*) filter (where f.action = 'booking')::bigint as booking
  from filtered f
  where f.operator_slug is not null
  group by f.operator_slug;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.get_operator_action_metrics(text[], integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.get_operator_action_metrics(text[], integer) to service_role;

-- DS-MFA-01/C: Staging-only session-aware Super Admin authorization.
-- This migration must NOT be applied to Supabase Production.
-- Rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.is_active_super_admin_session(uuid,uuid);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_super_admin_session(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_session_id uuid
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM auth.sessions s
    JOIN security.admin_members m ON m.user_id = s.user_id
    WHERE s.id = p_session_id
      AND s.user_id = p_user_id
      AND s.aal = 'aal2'
      AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after > now())
      AND m.role = 'super_admin'
      AND m.active = true
      AND m.revoked_at IS NULL
  );
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.is_active_super_admin_session(uuid,uuid)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_active_super_admin_session(uuid,uuid)
  TO service_role;
